newsitem.title: USA: Kideo raises $750,000 in private placement.
newsitem.headline: Kideo raises $750,000 in private placement.

text.p: Kideo Productions Inc said Friday it raised $750,000 in a private placement of 750 shares of a newly authorized series of preferred stock.
The shares were sold on May 13 at a liquidation value of $1,000 each in a transaction arranged with Gerard Klauer Mattison & Co Inc, placement agent, it said.
It said that, subject to satisfaction of closing conditions, it will have the option to sell up to 1,250 additional shares of the series at the same price.

The conditions include filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission to register the common shares into which the preferred shares are convertible. It said it expects to make the filing within the next 30 days.

The shares, designated as Series A preferred stock, will be convertible at the option of the holder into common sahres by July 12 or the date the SEC decclares the registration effective, whichever comes first.
Kidao said it has the right to call for the mandatory conversion of all outstanding shares of the series at any time after the first anniversary of the registration's effectivity.
The preferred shares are convertible at a conversion price of 80 percent of the prior three trading days' average closing bid price per share of Kideo's common stock on the Nasdaq, it said.
